provenance: New source translation; E3910-E3919 and E4000-E4009 reviewed.
context: Gate Keeper and Key Master trick party into killing the seal guardian. Monsters strengthen; Lady Marbas heals and warns the party before the two fiends return.
decisions: Cruel taunts preserved. Marbas's apparent death is a question, not a confirmed event. Sentences continue across corresponding rows.

translations.en: will pour through in hordes.
What will you do? What will you do? Hee hee hee hee!
First, we'll undo @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r troublesome seal.
Then we'll break the ancient seal and throw open the otherworldly gate.
Hee hee hee hee hee!
Come on, then! Can you stop us?
Come forth, Guardian!
Hee hee hee hee hee hee...
You fell for it perfectly!
That guardian was placed here by @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
to protect the seal! It was made to attack
anyone who approached, whoever they might be.
Hee hee hee hee hee hee!
And the key to destroying this seal of @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r
is defeating that very guardian!
We've waited hundreds of years for our deepest wish to come true.
Now it shall! You have our thanks, foolish adventurers!
Hee hee hee hee. I'll tell you one last useful thing.

translations.en: We aren't the only ones who want that gate opened.
Someone else has already begun moving to break the final seal!
Farewell, adventurers! Enjoy what little time remains
for your human world!
Leaving only their roaring laughter behind, the two monsters
vanished into the darkness.
Immediately afterward, a furious rumbling and an earthquake
shook the world so violently you could not stand.
Then only darkness remained...
A monster was lurking inside the box!
You had fought so many monsters that you began wondering
why so much fighting was necessary.
There were simply too many of them.
Was the strange stench and sinister aura caused by the sheer number
of monsters lurking in the labyrinth's darkness?
Above all, the monsters seemed unnaturally strong.
You could not shake that feeling.
Was it because the seal had broken?
With these thoughts in mind,
you advanced one step... then another.
Another monster appeared before you.
An enormous dragon? The moment you glimpsed its silhouette,
white light engulfed you.
You fools!
If you keep going like this, you'll die!
Listen carefully!
Now that @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r seal has broken,
every monster infesting these ruins has grown more active.
Before you go any farther,
do something about those pitiful levels of yours!
Hone your skills! Become seasoned warriors!
Then you should be able to protect the final seal.
Damn it... That extra spell
has nearly drained my magic!
Understand? Do not doubt a word I've said...
We shall meet again.
With a grin that lingered before your eyes,
@7rLady Marbas@0r disappeared.
Your party's magic and health were fully restored.
Almost as soon as @7rLady Marbas@0r vanished,
the white light surrounding you faded too,
and the labyrinth returned to normal.
The dragon that should have been before you was gone.
But you sensed something approaching from the darkness:
two distinct presences.
Hmm. A smell, a smell. What could it be?
Hee hee hee hee...
Humans, surely? They're right there.
The adventurers foolish enough to fall for our scheme.
No, not that. Yes, it's the smell of a fairy.
Hee hee hee... It seems some foolish fairy
has been helping you.
A mere fairy siding with these creatures instead of us?
Let's squeeze the name out of them, shall we?
Heh heh heh heh heh...
A little entertainment, then,
while we wait for the final door to open?
Precisely.
Well? Aren't you going to run? You may if you like,
but we'll chase you. Hee hee hee hee...
But this presence...
Is the fairy weakened? I can't sense any magic.
